🎓 How to Use the Enablement Bundler Skill

Use this skill in Joule to generate complete, AI-powered sales enablement bundles tailored to your deals.

💬

Trigger Phrases

Say any of these to Joule:

  • "Build a sales kit for [product]"
  • "Create enablement bundle"
  • "Generate talk track for CFO"
  • "Sales materials for EMEA"
  • "Objection handlers for [competitor]"
📝

Sample Prompt

Try this in Joule:

"Create a sales enablement bundle for SAP Ariba targeting a CPO at a $2B manufacturing company in EMEA. We're in evaluation stage competing against Coupa. Include talk track, proof points, and objection handlers."
📊

What You'll Get

  • Executive Brief — Deal summary for AE prep
  • Talk Tracks — Stage-specific conversation guides
  • Proof Points — Region & industry evidence
  • Objection Handlers — Ready responses to pushback
  • Asset Recommendations — What to share when
💡

Pro Tips

  • Include competitors — "We're up against Coupa and Oracle"
  • Specify pain points — Joule tailors messaging
  • Mention stage — Discovery vs. negotiation = different content
  • Ask for follow-up — "Now give me email templates"
